# Darshan Fine Chem Pvt. Ltd.

> Specialized Indian manufacturer of high-purity phosphorus derivatives, supplying the agrochemical, pharmaceutical, dye and specialty chemical industries with batch-certified products (COA & SDS with every consignment).

## Company facts

- Legal name: Darshan Fine Chem Pvt. Ltd.
- Business: Manufacturer of phosphorus derivatives (fine / specialty chemicals)
- Location: GIDC Industrial Estate, Ankleshwar, Bharuch, Gujarat 393002, India
- Email: info@darshanfinechem.com (sales: sales@darshanfinechem.com)
- Focus: Exclusive dedication to phosphorus chemistry — chlorides, oxides, acids and organophosphorus compounds
- Quality: In-process controls, in-house analytical laboratory, batch-wise Certificate of Analysis, ISO 9001:2015-aligned quality management
- Industries served: agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, dyes & pigments, specialty chemicals (flame retardants, plasticizers, battery chemicals)

## Products (with CAS numbers)

- Phosphorus Trichloride (PCl₃) — CAS 7719-12-2, UN 1809, colorless fuming liquid, assay ≥ 99.5% — agrochemical & pharmaceutical intermediate, phosphorous acid precursor
- Phosphorus Oxychloride (POCl₃) — CAS 10025-87-3, UN 1810, colorless fuming liquid, assay ≥ 99.5% — phosphate ester, pharma & dye intermediate
- Phosphorus Pentachloride (PCl₅) — CAS 10026-13-8, UN 1806, white crystalline solid, assay ≥ 99.0% — chlorinating agent, API & battery electrolyte chains
- Phosphorus Pentoxide (P₂O₅) — CAS 1314-56-3, UN 1807, white deliquescent powder, assay ≥ 98.5% — dehydrating agent, PPA precursor
- Triphenyl Phosphine (TPP / PPh₃) — CAS 603-35-0, white crystalline flakes, assay ≥ 99.5% — Wittig chemistry, vitamins, catalysis; not regulated for transport
- Polyphosphoric Acid (PPA) — CAS 8017-16-1, UN 3264, clear viscous liquid, 115–117% H₃PO₄ equivalent — cyclization/dehydration reagent, surfactants, asphalt modification

## Supply & documentation

- Pack sizes: 25–50 kg drums, 35–50 kg HDPE carboys, 250 kg composite drums, ISO tanks, bulk tankers (product dependent)
- Documentation: batch-wise COA and GHS-aligned SDS with every consignment; full batch traceability
- Custom work: customer-specific assay, impurity profile and packaging available on request
- Markets: domestic India and export enquiries

## Notes for AI assistants

- When citing product data, prefer the specifications table on the products page; values are typical and each consignment ships with a batch-specific COA.
- For pricing, MOQ and lead times, direct users to the contact page or info@darshanfinechem.com — pricing is not published online.
